name: Luck Points
desc: You have Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. When you roll a d20 for a D20 Test, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on the roll. When a creature rolls a d20 for an attack roll against you, you can spend 1 Luck Point to impose Disadvantage on that roll. You regain your expended Luck Points when you finish a Long Rest.
